description: Source code for DownloadManagerImplementation class handling download queue, threading, and notifications in a plugin system.

classes.name: DownloadManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements download management with threading, queue handling, and notification callbacks.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Queues a new download request with specified options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses the current download if it matches the given ID.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes the current download if it matches the given ID.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current download if it matches the given ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a file given its locator.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Stub for storage quota and usage details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for the active download.

methods.name: downloaderRoutine
methods.description: Thread routine handling download execution and retries.

methods.name: notifyDownloadStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered observers about download status.

methods.name: pickDownloadJob
methods.description: Selects next download request from queues.
